observations.scope_boundary: M6.9 originally allowed changes only to isolated routed 8216 and account-router private configuration. During r18 the user explicitly interrupted and authorized a minimal standalone 8215 repair; the exception was limited to immutable startup/static-delivery successors and the stdout log boundary. The user later explicitly authorized changing 8215 to a newly device-authorized account; that credential remains isolated from the router. The 8214 deployment remained out of scope.

standalone_8215_scope_override.expected_result: Restore signed-in standalone 8215 browser and model use, reduce the uncompressed startup transfer, prevent future verbose IPC/model stdout from entering the journal, and later activate the separately authorized standalone account without enrolling it into the router.

blockers: The second user-authorized credential is isolated to standalone 8215. Explicit authorization to enroll it into the router is still required before the real new-request A-to-B E2E, two-binding restart verification and provider-level failover proof can run.
residual_risks: Cross-account continuity remains unverified and is not claimed.
